name: IntentFence Policy Agent
description: Authorizes exact autonomous-agent actions against explicit policy, returns short-lived signed receipts, and scans MCP tool metadata for high-risk gaps.

skills.name: Budget-capped agent checkout
skills.description: Choose an IntentFence paid outcome and receive the exact endpoint, validated input, Agentic Wallet argv, MCP tool call, and Base USDC ceiling without signing or initiating payment.

skills.name: Self-service production policy pack
skills.description: Generate a runtime-specific fail-closed TypeScript guard, signed action and policy receipt, negative test vectors, and deployment checklist for 1 USDC through x402.
examples: Build an OpenAI Agents SDK function-tool guardrail for purchases up to 100 USD without a sales call.

skills.name: Fail-closed agent action authorization
skills.description: Bind an exact MCP, HTTP, A2A, or payment action to an allowlist, cost ceiling, retention ceiling, and optional action-specific human approval. Returns a five-minute ES256 receipt and never executes the action.
examples: Authorize this exact purchase tool call only if the resource is allowlisted and the quoted cost is at most 100 USD.

skills.name: MCP metadata risk scan
skills.description: Scan caller-supplied MCP tool definitions for missing schemas, conflicting annotations, absent approval binding, and missing cost boundaries without executing tools.
examples: Scan these MCP tools and identify consequential actions that lack approval binding.

skills.name: Agent payment preflight
skills.description: Evaluate caller-declared payment intent and return safe_to_proceed, needs_review, or denied before the caller invokes its downstream tool. IntentFence does not independently authorize or execute the action.
examples: Check whether a declared 428.20 USD quote is within a declared 500 USD ceiling.

skills.name: Live x402 endpoint readiness
skills.description: Make one bounded credential-free request to a public HTTPS endpoint, block redirects and private-network targets, validate its live x402 challenge, and return a signed receipt without paying the target.
examples: Check whether this endpoint currently returns a canonical Base USDC x402 challenge to an approved payee.

skills.name: Caller-observed x402 quote assessment
skills.description: Validate and sign the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED quote observed by the caller against a Base USDC ceiling, explicit payee allowlist, timeout, and resource binding. IntentFence never fetches or pays the target.
examples: Check that this exact x402 quote is canonical Base USDC, at most 0.10 USDC, pays an approved address, and is bound to the requested URL.
